name: A10-0253/2025 – David McAllister – § 42
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: Calls for the swift resumption of the Cyprus settlement talks within the UN-agreed framework, and urges against any unilateral actions that are inconsistent with a peaceful settlement; calls for the status of the buffer zone and the mandate of the UN Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus to be respected;
